notes.grade: An island reached only by boat, so it may have its own grade. Its ground is saturated vertex colour that its old Filmic curve (white 1) lifted a long way; under the shared curve it went a fifth darker than any other place, and the ground layer's deeper verge took it darker again (luminance 104 on develop, 86): exposure 1.6 brings it back to about the reference's 98. Its saturation is left alone in the compatibility renderer: AgX pales the gold trail towards sand, and trimmed to 0.85 it went grey; the gold is restored in the ground paint (LookProfile.GOLD_HUE) instead. Forward+ renders the island a quarter brighter than the compatibility renderer (luminance 123 against 94 at 1.6: its sea pale turquoise, its grass pale), so it takes 1.04 there (over FORWARD_EXPOSURE), and keeps more chroma than the continent's grade gives (saturation 1.15 over SATURATION_FORWARD): at the shared 0.69 its gold trail paled to straw (saturation 0.48).
notes.ground: Its grass came out of the verge treatment a deep saturated green (saturation 0.77 in its ground box, blue channel 17), above the reference's 0.51: it keeps more of its value and none of the extra chroma; in Forward+ it keeps still more value and gives up chroma, so its gold trail (the island's signature) is the most saturated thing on it. An island, so its trims draw no seam.
notes.grass: Coastal green. Its tufts stood 1.2 times brighter than its grass in the compatibility renderer and crowded the trail's value step (value_compat 0.9), and 0.7 times as bright in Forward+, where they read as dark speckle (value_forward 1.7; Forward+ trims act on linear colour, so 1.7 there is about 1.3 on screen).
notes.sky: The island declares only a dark background colour, which the grade lifted to a flat pale cyan wall above its sea; these are the sky it is painted with instead.
notes.water: lantern_water.gdshader's colours were picked in the compatibility renderer; in Forward+ they are decoded to linear albedo and the sea drawn at value 2.5, the compatibility renderer's deep blue-teal (luminance 63). At 3.0 it was a little paler than the island's grass needs to stand out against.
